summary.headline: Coforge board turmoil: Chairman and NRC Chair resigned after audit; management reaffirmed FY27 EBITDA margin guidance of 20.5-21%.
summary.overview: This was a governance-focused call, not an operating update, convened after two transition directors (the then Chairman and the then NRC Chair) resigned on 8 and 10 September 2026. The internal auditor (KPMG) found that board-evaluation reports were shared only with the Chairman and NRC Chair, and that the Chairman's lowest rating was not disclosed to the board. Management said the matter has no bearing on financial reporting, operations or outlook, and reaffirmed FY27 guidance. An interim chair (Vivek Sharma, until 31 January 2027) and a search firm (Egon Zender) are handling the appointment of two new independent directors and a permanent chair. The call did not provide any new financial figures.

segments.name: Segment-level financials
segments.commentary: No segment-level revenue, margin or growth figures were disclosed on the call; the call was governance-focused and the CFO only reiterated FY27 consolidated guidance (EBITDA margin 20.5-21%, EBIT margin at least 15.5%, FCF conversion above 100% of PAT).

segments.name: Practice mentions (no figures)
segments.commentary: Management named Neuron (AI operating system), Momentum Blue (forward deployed engineer academy), Mott squads (agent-human hybrid), an open-weight/open-source practice and a cloud engineering practice for the 17 September analyst seminar, but gave no revenue, deal or headcount numbers for any of them.

guidance_outlook: FY27 guidance (EBITDA margin 20.5-21%, EBIT margin at least 15.5%, FCF conversion above 100% of PAT) stated as intact, with no change.
Management said the Q2 FY27 large-deal signing ambition is on track, with two weeks left in the quarter, and that it could sign as many large deals in Q2 as in the full year two to three years back.

Two new independent directors to be appointed via a global search led by Egon Zender; chair selection to consider internal independent directors and external candidates, excluding executive directors.
Interim Chairperson's tenure stated as until 31 January 2027.
demand_pricing: Management said demand outlook is robust, and AI is creating new demand pools that are supply constrained and favour focused firms.

Investor/analyst seminar scheduled for 17 September to cover Neuron (AI operating system), Momentum Blue (forward deployed engineer academy), Mott squads (agent-human hybrids), open-weight/open-source practice and cloud engineering.

qa_highlights.question: Are other people beyond the two ex-directors being questioned, and what is the process for the board evaluation report audit?
qa_highlights.answer: Anil Chanana (Audit Committee Chair) said the matter was fully covered by KPMG, no other observations on it so far; remaining audit areas are still in progress and not expected to concern board members.

qa_highlights.question: How was the independence of Vivek Sharma assessed, and what are the concerns?
qa_highlights.answer: Beth Boucher (NRC Chair) said an 11-month search with 21 candidates and 8 shortlisted was run; NRC assessed independence; shareholders elected him with over 83% support against a 50% threshold.

qa_highlights.question: What is the fallback if replacement directors are not found, and what are the profiles being considered?
qa_highlights.answer: Vivek Sharma said two independent directors are being sought globally with governance, professional expertise and strategic perspective; profile details not shared; no fallback timeline was given.

qa_highlights.question: Will the internal audit of hire-to-retire and board reporting recur?
qa_highlights.answer: Anil Chanana said it was a first-time scope expansion by KPMG; recurrence depends on risk profiling, with newer risks such as AI governance added.

qa_highlights.question: Are the current issues related to past strategy or performance and will they affect future performance?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said no; strategy and execution unchanged, and the board said the Encora acquisition decision was unanimous after debate.

qa_highlights.question: Did the board have dissent on the Encora acquisition, and how is NRC composed?
qa_highlights.answer: Board said decisions including Encora were unanimous with no dissent; NRC now has four members, three of them independent (Beth Boucher as chair, Anil Chanana and Vivek Sharma).

qa_highlights.question: Does Vivek Sharma's reported AI advisory role to Advent affect his independence?
qa_highlights.answer: Vivek Sharma said he advises multiple CEOs and companies, and affirmed his fiduciary duty to Coforge.

risks_watch: Permanent Chairperson and two new independent directors not yet appointed; interim chair tenure ends 31 January 2027.
Further audit areas (internal audit of other processes, including AI governance review) still in progress; any further findings are unknown.
Board independence perception: only three independent directors out of seven, and questions raised about Vivek Sharma's external advisory role.
Q2 FY27 large-deal signing ambition and the 17 September analyst seminar are near-term checkpoints.
Board refresh and continuity given relatively new board members and reduced tenure.
summary.management_tone: Defensive and emphatic on governance, repeatedly asserting unanimity and fiduciary duty, while declining to give detail on the audit findings, candidate profiles or timelines. On financials and strategy, management was confident and unequivocal in reaffirming guidance with no changes.
key_quotes: Our near-term, medium-term and long-term outlook remains unchanged and our F527 guidance remains intact.
